scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html config.js monetization.js game.js manifest.json sw.js icon.svg privacy.html www/
scripts.android:add: npm run build && npx cap add android && ./scripts/setup-android.sh
scripts.ios:add: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
